ask: Post this reel as a trial first, and share it with followers only if it does well: https://cdn.example.com/latte-art.mp4

arguments.content: Ten seconds of latte art, one shaky hand.

media.alt_text: A barista pouring a leaf into a latte

steps.why: A trial reel needs REELS and one video, set in the same call. SS_PERFORMANCE: Instagram shares it with followers if it does well; MANUAL would leave that to the user. One setting for the post, so every Instagram account on it gets a trial.
Bad values are skipped, not refused: confirm content_type REELS and trial_reel_enabled true before saying it is set.

say: Saved to Acme as an Instagram draft: a trial reel, shown to non-followers first and shared with your followers only if it does well. Nothing goes out yet. Schedule it?
never: A trial on an image or a carousel: it goes out as a normal post.
Saying it is a trial before the read-back shows it.
A video link the user didn't give.
